context: Writing a Python script to parse filenames and organize resumes/cover letters hierarchically.
user_intent: Organize a messy Downloads folder into a strict Corporate -> Name -> Company -> Designation -> Resume/Cover Letter hierarchy, and verify the AI's logic on edge cases.
why_user_made_such_thinking: High cognitive structure. The user models systems hierarchically and seeks to ensure the AI's interpretation matches their internal model exactly.
why_user_performed_this_way: Investigatory probe pattern. The user verifies system integrity by testing boundary conditions (e.g., 'what if there is no company name').
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: High satisfaction assumed, as they moved directly to requesting a Sophron sync based on the interaction.
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes, correctly deduced the missing company branch logic and provided exact folder contents as proof.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes. The edge-case files were flattened to Corporate Folder\Name\Cover Letter\ exactly as logic dictates.
evolutionary_takeaways: User behavior reflects a high-trust, high-verify paradigm. They will give loose, streamed instructions (Axiom 7) but will rigorously audit the deterministic outcome (Axiom 1).
